description: This file defines a JavaScript class ygDDList that extends YAHOO.util.DDProxy for drag-and-drop list functionality, including methods for starting, ending, and handling drag-over events, as well as reloading dashlets after drop.

classes.name: ygDDList
classes.description: A class implementing drag-and-drop list behavior with custom styling and dashlet reloading.

classes.name: ygDDListBoundary
classes.description: A class representing a boundary element for drag-and-drop operations, extending YAHOO.util.DDTarget.

methods.name: startDrag
methods.description: Initializes the drag operation, sets styles, and prepares the element for dragging.

methods.name: endDrag
methods.description: Finalizes the drag operation, restores styles, and triggers dashlet reload if needed.

methods.name: afterEndDrag
methods.description: Placeholder for additional actions after drag ends.

methods.name: onDrag
methods.description: Handles the drag event; currently empty.

methods.name: onDragOver
methods.description: Handles the drag-over event, reordering list items based on cursor position.

methods.name: onDragEnter
methods.description: Handles the event when a draggable enters a target area.

methods.name: onDragOut
methods.description: Handles the event when a draggable leaves a target area.
